name: Magyair Hungarian Airlines
blurb: A Hungarian airline from Budapest, connecting Central Europe with Western Europe and the Red Sea. "Unlock your vacation."

about: Magyair Hungarian Airlines is headquartered in Budapest, with the goal of connecting Central Europe. Its promise to passengers: "Unlock your vacation."
network: From Budapest it flies to London Heathrow, Paris, Frankfurt, Munich and Zurich, and south to Egypt: Cairo, Alexandria, and the Red Sea and Nile resorts of Hurghada, Sharm el-Sheikh and Luxor.
